# Source classification: TASVEG {#sec-source}

In this document we are focusing on TASVEG, a comprehensive digital map of Tasmania's vegetation, including sub-Antarctic Macquarie Island [@TASVEG_3;@TASVEG_5]. 

The TASVEG dataset includes ecological and spatial information, and for the purposes of this document we will differentiate between mapping units and vegetation communities. 

The majority of the mapping units represent vegetation communities, including coastal heathlands, eucalypt forest and alpine communities. The technical manual [@KitchenerHarris_2013] includes description for each of the 159 mapping units, most of them ecological vegetation communities. The format of these descriptions is consistent, descriptive and cross-referenced with relevant literature and other processes. 

## Components of TASVEG

TASVEG has several components and we are going to use them in different steps of the process. 

- The *Technical manual* [@KitchenerHarris_2013] has important information for @sec-alignment and was used by all interpreters as the main source of ecological information 
- TASVEG 5.0 from <https://www.theLIST.tas.gov.au> ©State of Tasmania, is a dataset including:
    - spatial data in mapinfo and shapefile formats (used in @sec-synthesis),
    - metadata in PDF format,
    - fire attributes in DBF format (used in @sec-alignment).

Instructions for downloading TASVEG 5.0 data is available in @sec-download.
